'''Tennum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Bothan male]] who served as the leader of [[TechTank]], an [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] gang that operated from a [[TechTank shop|concealed shop]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sinasu]] took shelter amongst [[TechTank]] after becoming embroiled in a gang war with the Hutt [[Noako]] and after a group of Sinasu's agents arrived at the TechTank base with a cargo of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragons]], Tennum sent the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[TT-3P0]] to greet them.
